title: The Paper Interviews #3 with Sabrina Impacciatore

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Welcome back for another interview with a cast member from The Paper.
sentences.zh: 欢迎再次收看由《The Paper》剧组成员参加的访谈。

sentences.en: And we should probably tell you, we watched the first four episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们或许应该告诉大家，我们看过了前四集。

sentences.en: We have watched them.
sentences.zh: 我们真的看过了。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 真的太棒了。

sentences.en: It's really good.
sentences.zh: 确实非常好。

sentences.en: It's very hard not to say more, but we are not allowed.
sentences.zh: 很难忍住不剧透，但我们不能说。

sentences.en: I think people are going to be happy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大家会满意的。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I think it feels like The Office.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它很有《办公室》的感觉。

sentences.en: Like, it's very clear that this is the same universe.
sentences.zh: 就是那种很明显属于同一个宇宙的感觉。

sentences.en: Okay, that's all I think we can say.
sentences.zh: 好了，我觉得我们只能透露这么多了。

sentences.en: Yeah, we've probably said too much.
sentences.zh: 对，我们可能已经说得太多了。

sentences.en: Well, wait, I do want to say one more thing.
sentences.zh: 等一下，我还想说一件事。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: I want to say that we are not sponsored by Peacock or NBC.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我们没有接受 Peacock 或 NBC 的赞助。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, we are not.
sentences.zh: 对，没有，我们真的没有。

sentences.en: I just want to say that because I just want people to know this is not an ad.
sentences.zh: 我只是想说明这一点，因为我想让大家知道这不是广告。

sentences.en: For Peacock or NBC.
sentences.zh: 针对 Peacock 或 NBC 的广告。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, basically, here's what happened.
sentences.zh: 对，基本上事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Greg invited Jenna and I to visit the set and to meet the caSt.
sentences.zh: 格雷格邀请詹娜和我去片场参观并见见演员们。

sentences.en: And he shared with us some of our old crew was there.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉我们，我们以前的一些剧组成员也在那儿。

sentences.en: We couldn't wait.
sentences.zh: 我们迫不及待地就去了。

sentences.en: And Greg has always been amazing to Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 而且格雷格对《办公室女士》一直都非常好。

sentences.en: He's a huge supporter of the show.
sentences.zh: 他是我们节目的超级支持者。

sentences.en: And we went and went to the set.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就去了片场。

sentences.en: And then he offered us an early sneak peek of the paper pilot and said maybe if we liked it, we could break it down because he said he's a huge fan of how we break down episodes.
sentences.zh: 然后他让我们提前先睹为快了《The Paper》的试播集，并说如果我们喜欢的话或许可以剖析一下，因为他说他非常喜欢我们剖析剧集的方式。

sentences.en: And so it all came together really organically.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切结合得非常自然。

sentences.en: And I'm so glad we got to do this.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们能做这件事。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: And it just it meant so much to me that Greg trusts us.
sentences.zh: 格雷格能信任我们，对我和说真的意义重大。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: With his new baby, basically, you know.
sentences.zh: 基本上就像是对待他的新宝贝一样，你懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Greg, you're going to hear.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，你一定会听到这些的。

sentences.en: Yes, you are.
sentences.zh: 你绝对会听到。

sentences.en: We loved it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: You know, lady, I do think that the rest of the cast is a little jealous that we got to see it early.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，女士，我觉得其他演员对于我们能提前看到这一点有点嫉妒。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I maybe am lording it over their heads a little bit.
sentences.zh: 而且我可能在他们面前稍微有点显摆。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Did you tease Rain on your lunch?
sentences.zh: 你吃午饭时拿这事逗雷恩了吗？

sentences.en: Were you like, Rain, guess what?
sentences.zh: 你会不会说，雷恩，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Yes, I was like, Rain.
sentences.zh: 对，我就说，雷恩。

sentences.en: I got to see it and you didn't.
sentences.zh: 我能看到，而你不能。

sentences.en: I literally did.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么做了。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我看了。

sentences.en: I had lunch with Rain and I told him that I got to see it and that I wouldn't tell him anything.
sentences.zh: 我和雷恩吃午饭时告诉他我有幸看到了，而且我什么都不会告诉他。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I bet that made him crazy.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌这把他急坏了。

sentences.en: Well, listen, we are really excited because today we are sharing our interview with Sabrina Impecciatore.
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，我们真的很兴奋，因为今天我们要分享我们对萨布里纳·因佩恰托雷的采访。

sentences.en: You might know her from season two of The White Lotus.
sentences.zh: 你可能从《白莲花度假村》第二季中认识她。

sentences.en: She's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: And she is phenomenal in the paper.
sentences.zh: 她在《报社》里的表现简直惊艳。

sentences.en: And her story of how she got her role on the paper is amazing.
sentences.zh: 她讲到自己是如何得到《报社》里的角色的，那个故事太神奇了。

sentences.en: While we were talking to her, they actually called her to set during the interview, but I could have kept talking to her for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我们在跟她聊的时候，他们在采访中途实际上叫她去片场，但我真想跟她再聊一个小时。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: I, like, want to go on a road trip with her and just hear her talk.
sentences.zh: 我简直想跟她一起去公路旅行，就听她说话。

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I want to know even more things.
sentences.zh: 我还想知道更多的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, without further delay, here is our interview with Sabrina Impecciatore.
sentences.zh: 那么，废话不多说，这就是我们对萨布里纳·因佩恰托雷的采访。

sentences.en: Well, it is so exciting to get to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 能有机会跟你聊聊，真的让人太激动了。

sentences.en: Will you tell us your name and your character name?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我们你的名字和你的角色名字吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Allora, my name is Sabrina Impecciatore and my character's name is Esmeralda Grand.
sentences.zh: 那么，我的名字是萨布里纳·因佩恰托雷，我角色的名字是埃斯梅拉达·格兰德。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a little bit about what your character's story in the show is?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们简单讲讲你在剧中的角色经历吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的天哪。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: What does she do?
sentences.zh: 她做了什么？

sentences.en: What does she do in her job?
sentences.zh: 她在工作中做些什么？

sentences.en: What doesn't she do?
sentences.zh: 有什么是她没做过的？

sentences.en: I would say, because she does everything she can to just try to stay where she is.
sentences.zh: 我想说，因为她竭尽所能只是为了留在她现在的职位上。

sentences.en: This is kind of crazy character.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有点疯狂的角色。

sentences.en: Like, she could do anything.
sentences.zh: 比如，她什么都做得出来。

sentences.en: To me, she's someone that needs to survive.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，她是一个需要生存的人。

sentences.en: And so, but for her to survive, it's a very personal concept, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以，对她而言生存是一个非常个人的概念，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So, every time she feels threatened by something, she uses anything she can, even the worst things possible, just to protect herself.
sentences.zh: 所以，每当她感到受到某种威胁时，她会利用任何能用的手段，甚至是可能最糟糕的手段，只为了保护自己。

sentences.en: So, I see her like a little wild animal.
sentences.zh: 所以我把她看作是一只野性的小动物。

sentences.en: And then she's the only Italian.
sentences.zh: 而且她是唯一的意大利人。

sentences.en: She moved here and she doesn't want to leave.
sentences.zh: 她搬到了这里，而且不想离开。

sentences.en: Like, she wants just to be here and keep living in this, in this country.
sentences.zh: 比如，她只想待在这里，继续在这个国家生活。

sentences.en: And she works in this office, but she could actually do anything else because she's not a real journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 她在办公室工作，但实际上她什么别的工作都能做，因为她不是真正的记者。

sentences.en: So, she is just someone that pretends to be anything because she just has to make it.
sentences.zh: 所以，她只是一个假装成各种身份的人，因为她必须混下去。

sentences.en: Are you the only actual reporter at the paper?
sentences.zh: 你是报社里唯一真正的记者吗？

sentences.en: Is that your job?
sentences.zh: 那是你的工作吗？

sentences.en: No, not really.
sentences.zh: 不，其实不是。

sentences.en: Like, my job was to be the editor-in-chief of TTT Online.
sentences.zh: 比如，我的工作是TTT网的主编。

sentences.en: But then, and she was very happy about this, very proud.
sentences.zh: 但后来，她对此感到非常高兴，非常骄傲。

sentences.en: And then this guy arrives, like the new, and she is literally kicked out of her office.
sentences.zh: 接着这个家伙来了，也就是新来的人，她字面意义上被赶出了自己的办公室。

sentences.en: So, she struggles a lot because of that.
sentences.zh: 所以她为此挣扎了很久。

sentences.en: And then she just tries to find her space in this new, you know, in this new hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 然后她只是试图在这个新的，你知道的，在这个新的层级结构中找到自己的空间。

sentences.en: And so, of course, she is the one that wants always to be in front.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，她总是那个想要冲在最前面的人。

sentences.en: Like, she, she's also, to me, this is something that, because I've been creating this character with Greg and Michael and all the other writers.
sentences.zh: 比如，她，对我来说这也是因为我和格雷格、迈克尔以及所有其他编剧一起塑造了这个角色。

sentences.en: Now, I was very, very inspired by, already by the sides during the audition.
sentences.zh: 从试镜时的台词开始，我就已经受到了非常非常大的启发。

sentences.en: And so, then I decided to, I don't know, I didn't decide.
sentences.zh: 然后，我就决定去，我不知道，我其实没决定。

sentences.en: Things just arrived.
sentences.zh: 事情就这么发生了。

sentences.en: So, to me, somehow, she thinks that through this documentary, one day maybe she could become a star.
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，不知为何，她觉得通过这部纪录片，也许有一天她能成为明星。

sentences.en: So, she also uses the camera to suggest that idea.
sentences.zh: 所以，她也利用摄像机来暗示这种想法。

sentences.en: That's why I decided to have this kind of hair, like a diva from the 40s, to suggest, hey, look at me.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我决定留这种发型，就像40年代的歌剧名伶一样，暗示着，嘿，看我。

sentences.en: I'm a superstar, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是个超级巨星。

sentences.en: And so, she acts like a star.
sentences.zh: 所以，她表现得像个明星。

sentences.en: She behaves like a star.
sentences.zh: 她举止像个明星。

sentences.en: She, she thinks big.
sentences.zh: 她，她志存高远。

sentences.en: She is, she's big.
sentences.zh: 她就是，她很大牌。

sentences.en: The way she dresses, the way she acts, she is also very manipulative.
sentences.zh: 她的穿着，她的举止，她也很善于操纵他人。

sentences.en: She uses everything, very manipulative.
sentences.zh: 她利用一切，非常善于操控。

sentences.en: And, what a fun character.
sentences.zh: 而且，多么有趣的一个角色啊。

sentences.en: I love her.
sentences.zh: 我爱死她了。

sentences.en: I can't wait to watch this.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想看这个了。

sentences.en: You know, it reminds me a lot of how Michael Scott loved the camera, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我想起了迈克尔·斯科特是如何喜爱摄像机的，对吧？

sentences.en: And Andy, he thought he was going to be a big star.
sentences.zh: 还有安迪，他以为自己会成为一个大明星。

sentences.en: He was very excited when the documentary airs.
sentences.zh: 纪录片播出时他非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So, I sort of see a little bit of that theme.
sentences.zh: 所以，我从某种程度上看到了这样一点主题。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about the audition, your process, and how you got your job on the paper?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们聊聊试镜、你的流程，以及你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So, that was, I have to be short because it's a long story.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是，我得简短点，因为这说来话长。

sentences.en: But I was shooting a movie in Cape Town.
sentences.zh: 但我当时正在开普敦拍电影。

sentences.en: I was in Cape Town, South Africa, since three months, far away from home and everything.
sentences.zh: 我在南非开普敦呆了三个月，远离家乡和一切。

sentences.en: And I am literally entering in the flight, going back to Italy.
sentences.zh: 而我当时正准备登机回意大利。

sentences.en: And I got a call from my agent from LA.
sentences.zh: 我接到了来自洛杉矶经纪人的电话。

sentences.en: She said, Sabrina, did you, did you read the email?
sentences.zh: 她说，萨布丽娜，你，你看了邮件吗？

sentences.en: I said, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，没有。

sentences.en: What email?
sentences.zh: 什么邮件？

sentences.en: I was packaging.
sentences.zh: 我正在打包行李。

sentences.en: I was saying goodbye to the crew.
sentences.zh: 我在跟剧组人员告别。

sentences.en: She had, do you have to read this email right now?
sentences.zh: 她说，你现在必须得看这封邮件吗？

sentences.en: But I am almost flying.
sentences.zh: 但我马上就要起飞了。

sentences.en: So, I read the email and there was the call for this audition.
sentences.zh: 于是我看了邮件，里面有这个试镜的通知。

sentences.en: And they gave me 24 hours to prepare 11 pages in English.
sentences.zh: 他们只给我24小时用英语准备11页纸的剧本。

sentences.en: 24 hours was exactly the time of the flight back to Italy.
sentences.zh: 24小时刚好就是飞回意大利的飞行时间。

sentences.en: But me, I felt, I cannot do an audition just coming out of the flight after.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，我刚下飞机根本没办法做试镜。

sentences.en: And so, I was telling my agent, please, please, try to get some time more.
sentences.zh: 所以，我告诉经纪人，求求你，求求你，尽量多争取一点时间。

sentences.en: How can I learn these things?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能把这些东西背下来？

sentences.en: I'm flying.
sentences.zh: 我在飞机上。

sentences.en: I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 我很累。

sentences.en: I'm upset.
sentences.zh: 我很沮丧。

sentences.en: And she said, I don't know if I can make it.
sentences.zh: 她说，我不知道能不能行。

sentences.en: I'll write you.
sentences.zh: 我再写信给你。

sentences.en: And so, now just go.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在你先登机吧。

sentences.en: So, I flew for 10 hours and then I arrived in Doha.
sentences.zh: 于是，我飞了10个小时，然后到达了多哈。

sentences.en: I can't remember.
sentences.zh: 我记不清了。

sentences.en: I opened my email and she wrote me, we got one day more.
sentences.zh: 我打开邮箱，她写信告诉我，我们多争取到了一天时间。

sentences.en: So, I was very excited, but still like, I can't make it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我非常兴奋，但同时又觉得，我还是做不到。

sentences.en: Like, this is very long to learn.
sentences.zh: 就觉得，这太长了，根本背不下来。

sentences.en: 11 pages of monologues.
sentences.zh: 11页的独白。

sentences.en: But I read this site and I felt in love.
sentences.zh: 但我看了这个网站，然后坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: You know, it's like love at first sight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像一见钟情一样。

sentences.en: I was like, oh my God, this is too brilliant.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，天哪，这太棒了。

sentences.en: This is too funny.
sentences.zh: 这太好笑了。

sentences.en: And guess what?
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I had never saw The Office in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子从来没看过《办公室》。

sentences.en: I didn't know about this show.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道这部剧。

sentences.en: I was the only one on this planet that hadn't seen this show.
sentences.zh: 我是这个星球上唯一没看过这部剧的人。

sentences.en: So, the first two episodes, I saw them on the flight from Cape Town to Rome.
sentences.zh: 所以，前两集我是从开普敦飞往罗马的航班上看的。

sentences.en: Oh!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: And I felt like, oh my God, what a weird project.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得，天哪，这是什么奇怪的项目。

sentences.en: That doesn't look like anything familiar.
sentences.zh: 看起来跟见过的任何东西都不一样。

sentences.en: That's so weird.
sentences.zh: 太诡异了。

sentences.en: And this acting is so believable.
sentences.zh: 而且这演技太逼真了。

sentences.en: It looks really like it.
sentences.zh: 看起来真的很像那么回事。

sentences.en: And the light is so bad.
sentences.zh: 而且光线这么差。

sentences.en: I'm going to be so ugly.
sentences.zh: 我会显得好丑。

sentences.en: That was the main concern.
sentences.zh: 那是我最主要的担忧。

sentences.en: So, then I arrived in Rome.
sentences.zh: 于是，后来我到了罗马。

sentences.en: After three months, I don't see my mom and nothing.
sentences.zh: 三个月没见我妈，什么都没做。

sentences.en: But I called my mom and said, mom, forget about me.
sentences.zh: 但我给我妈打电话说，妈，别管我了。

sentences.en: Have an audition tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天有个试镜。

sentences.en: So, we can't see.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们见不了面。

sentences.en: We can't.
sentences.zh: 我们见不了。

sentences.en: So, I spend all night long to study the sites.
sentences.zh: 所以我花了一整晚的时间研究这些片段。

sentences.en: I find an American girl.
sentences.zh: 我找了一个美国女孩。

sentences.en: It's a long story.
sentences.zh: 说来话长。

sentences.en: That she comes to my place and we study, study, study, study.
sentences.zh: 她来到我家，然后我们不停地学习、学习、学习、学习。

sentences.en: And then I do this Zoom meeting with all my luggages looking at me.
sentences.zh: 然后我带着我所有的行李，它们看着我，进行了这场 Zoom 会议。

sentences.en: You know, the luggages.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些行李。

sentences.en: I couldn't touch the luggage.
sentences.zh: 我碰都不能碰那些行李。

sentences.en: I couldn't open that.
sentences.zh: 我没法打开它们。

sentences.en: They were there.
sentences.zh: 它们就摆在那儿。
